correctness.rationale: Fix residues modulo A and sort with multiplicity the weights uG+vH. The second weight W2(r) is the first N of that residue having two representations; g1=max_r W2(r)-A. Reduction u=(b+1)q+s, z=q+v uses (b+1)G=H+bA, giving sG+zH+qbA. Exact residue case division r=0,1..b^2,r>b^2 and subcases e=0 or e>0 yields all W2(r) and a unique maximizer r=A-2b. Substitution gives the cubic g1, one factorization there and at least two above. Independent direct dynamic-programming counts for every b=2..25 agree, including b=2 and the unique residue. The proof treats all b, not an extrapolated sequence.
residual_risks: Dynamic programming is bounded; the all-b result rests on the residue-weight case proof.
